title: Midjourney Pricing in 2026: Is It Worth the Cost?

facts.fact: Midjourney offers four monthly subscription tiers: Basic, Standard, Pro, and Mega.
facts.quote: so you find four monthly options

facts.fact: Midjourney's Basic plan costs $10 per month when billed monthly.
Midjourney's Basic plan costs $8 per month when billed annually.
Midjourney's Standard plan costs $30 per month when billed monthly.
Midjourney's Standard plan costs $24 per month when billed annually.
Midjourney's Pro plan costs $60 per month when billed monthly.
Midjourney's Pro plan costs $48 per month when billed annually.
Midjourney's Mega plan costs $120 per month when billed monthly.
Midjourney's Mega plan costs $96 per month when billed annually.
Annual billing reduces the price of all Midjourney plans by 20%.
facts.quote: Annual billing knocks 20% off all plans

facts.fact: Extra fast GPU time can be purchased on any Midjourney tier at $4 per hour.
facts.quote: extra fast GPU time is also available on any tier at $4 per hour

facts.fact: Midjourney's Basic plan includes 3.3 fast GPU hours per month, which the page says is about 200 images.
Midjourney's Standard plan includes 15 fast GPU hours per month, which the page says is about 900 images.
Midjourney's Pro plan includes 30 fast GPU hours per month, which the page says is about 1,800 images.
Midjourney's Mega plan includes 60 fast GPU hours per month, which the page says is about 3,600 images.
According to the page, a standard image generated in fast mode uses roughly 1 minute of GPU time.
facts.unit: minute of GPU time per image
facts.quote: a standard image generation in fast mode costs roughly 1 minute of GPU time

facts.fact: Midjourney's concurrent job limit is 3 on the Basic and Standard plans and 12 on the Pro and Mega plans.
facts.quote: The second is 12 concurrent jobs, up from 3

facts.fact: Stealth Mode is not included on the Basic or Standard plans and is included on the Pro and Mega plans.
facts.quote: The first is Stealth Mode, which keeps your generated images off the public gallery.

facts.fact: Unused fast GPU hours do not roll over to the next billing cycle.
facts.quote: But once your fast hours are gone, they're gone, no rollover to the next billing cycle.

facts.fact: Fast mode generates images in 10 to 30 seconds, according to the page.
facts.quote: It generates images in 10 to 30 seconds and draws directly from your monthly GPU hour allocation.

facts.fact: Upscaling and running variations each take 2 to 4 minutes in fast mode, according to the page.
facts.quote: Upscaling and running variations can each take 2 to 4 minutes

facts.fact: Per Midjourney's own documentation, Relax mode generation takes anywhere from 0 to 30 minutes.
facts.quote: Generation takes anywhere from 0 to 30 minutes ([per Midjourney's own docs]

facts.fact: The page was last updated on August 20, 2026.
